root_cause.text: The Bluetooth socket destructor functions (`hci_sock_destruct`, `iso_sock_destruct`, `l2cap_sock_destruct`, and `sco_sock_destruct`) fail to purge the socket's error queue (`sk_error_queue`), resulting in a memory leak of queued socket buffers (SKBs) when the socket is destroyed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `skb_queue_purge(&sk->sk_error_queue)` to the destructor functions in `net/bluetooth/hci_sock.c`, `net/bluetooth/iso.c`, `net/bluetooth/l2cap_sock.c`, and `net/bluetooth/sco.c` to prevent SKBs queued for TX timestamping from leaking.
